British Honduras was the British colony on the Caribbean coast of Central America, declared in 1862 and made a Crown colony in 1871. It is now Belize.

For two centuries the settlement of the Baymen had no clear legal status. In 1859 Britain and Guatemala signed a treaty fixing its border, and Britain then declared a colony. Guatemala later said the treaty was void because a road Britain had promised was never built, the root of the territorial dispute that still runs.

The colony lived on mahogany and chicle, later on sugar and citrus, and was ruled by a governor and a small elite. Self-government came in 1964 under George Price, and the colony was renamed Belize in 1973 before independence in 1981. It was part of the British Empire for over a century.
sum: British Honduras was the British colony on the Caribbean coast of Central America, declared in 1862 and made a Crown colony in 1871. It is now Belize.
